causes.label: demand
causes.quote: High temperatures on both days in Victoria led to a new record demand on Friday. As a result of the extreme demand and limited import capability, the half-hour spot price exceeded $5000/MWh on four occasions, once on Thursday and three times on Friday.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Planned network outages of a 132kV transmission line between Wagga and Yanco in southern New South Wales and a transformer at Robertstown in South Australia were scheduled for both Thursday and Friday. The combination of constraints required to manage these outages led to a significant restriction on flows from Snowy into Victoria, which was far greater than forecast.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Actual flows were limited to around 300 MW when the spot price was above $5000/MWh. This compares to a nominal limit of around 1700 MW under normal conditions.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Whilst there was rebidding pursuant to clause 3.8.22 that did contribute to the price exceeding $5000/MWh, its impacts were minor when compared to the network outage.

constraints_named.quote: At 1.06 pm, effective immediately the constraints managing the outage of the Wagga to Yanco line in New South Wales were revoked from the market systems.
The constraints managing the Robertstown transformer outage in South Australia remained in the market systems until 2.04 pm.

interconnectors_named.name: Snowy to Victoria interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: The combination of constraints required to manage these outages led to a significant restriction on flows from Snowy into Victoria, which was far greater than forecast.

network_outages.quote: Planned network outages of a 132kV transmission line between Wagga and Yanco in southern New South Wales and a transformer at Robertstown in South Australia were scheduled for both Thursday and Friday. The combination of constraints required to manage these outages led to a significant restriction on flows from Snowy into Victoria, which was far greater than forecast.

rebid_set_price.quote: Whilst there was rebidding pursuant to clause 3.8.22 that did contribute to the price exceeding $5000/MWh, its impacts were minor when compared to the network outage.
